posts.title: Sany unveils autonomous electric construction machinery
posts.description: At bauma China 2026 in Shanghai, Chinese construction machinery manufacturer Sany is presenting several electric machines specifically developed for autonomous operation. The new products include a battery-electric mining truck in the 100-ton class with 800-volt technology and an electric roller with over 1,000 kWh of battery capacity.

posts.title: Bolt launches autonomous ride-hailing service in Luxembourg
posts.description: Bolt has officially launched its self-driving car service in Luxembourg. The vehicles operate in autonomous mode at SAE Level 4 and are equipped with Pony.ai's seventh-generation driving system. The fleet consists of the electric SUV Arcfox Alpha T5.

posts.title: Arriva secures two-billion-euro contract for electric buses in North Holland
posts.description: Arriva has secured a long-term contract for bus services in the northwest of the Dutch province of North Holland. The agreement includes the deployment of over 200 electric buses as well as adjustments to the route network. With this, Arriva continues its growth trajectory in the Netherlands following several major contracts.
